note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Hazardous streams are not placed in ordinary bins. The route is confirmed in writing first.
The Victorian guidance says to keep hazardous substances separate from general waste.

practicalCriteria: The learner separates debris into streams and identifies the hazardous ones.
The learner does not discharge wastewater or place debris in ordinary collection without a confirmed route.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: A waste route is not yet confirmed in writing.
Wastewater discharge is proposed without a confirmed route.
